name: Drawing Set
keywords: blueprint architecture drawing cyanotype engineering title block
idea: The page is a set of cyanotype drawing sheets: Prussian-blue ground, white line work, title blocks, and one red approval stamp.
note: Live: dimension line draws itself in; click "Approve sheet" to stamp.
borrowed: Architectural and engineering drawing sets: cyanotype blueprints, double sheet borders with zone letters, title blocks (drawn / checked / sheet / revision), dimension lines with arrowheads, the rubber approval stamp.
mood: Methodical, credible, "measure twice". Suits architecture, engineering, technical consulting, case-study heavy portfolios.

type.meta: Display & labels · Barlow Condensed 500–700, tracked caps

motion: Line work draws in with `stroke-dashoffset`, 1.6s expo-out, once.
Stamp lands with an overshoot: scale 2.2 → 1, rotate −12°, ink mask for wear.
Hover: dashed outline buttons fill solid (pencil → ink).
watchouts: Only one stamp per view. It's an event, not decoration.
Grid opacity stays low (6–16%) or it fights the text.
Zone letters around the frame need space. Drop them on phones.
